content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CRS Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the bio-data cum application proforma (Annexure) enclosed with the circular, in duplicate. Attach last five years APARs duly attested, Vigilance Clearance certificate and Integrity Certificate. Employer verifies and certifies that the particulars furnished by the applicant are correct. Forward the application through proper channel to the Office of Commissioner of Railway Safety, Bangalore-560023. Application must be received within 60 days from publication in Employment News on 24.10.2026. Make sure it reaches by 23 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CRS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 23-12-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CRS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Sr. Inspector (Technical).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CRS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Bio-data cum application proforma (Annexure-A / Annexure-I) enclosed with this circular) and send it to Office of Commissioner of Railway Safety, 2nd Floor, Rail Sanraksha Bhawan, Behind Divisional Railway Manager Office, Bangalore -560023, by through proper channel, to reach by 23-12-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level-7 of 7th CPC Pay Matrix (Rs. 44900-142400), pre-revised GP Rs. 4600.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligibility as mentioned in the Recruitment Rules (Column 11 of GSR 37 in Annexure 2); open on deputation to officials of Central/State Governments, UTs, Universities, recognized research institutes, PSUs and Statutory or Autonomous Organisations.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open only on deputation to officials of Central Government, State Governments, Union Territories, Universities, recognized research institutes, PSUs or Statutory or Autonomous Organisations. The vacancy is in Civil Engineering. Applications must come through proper channel.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after the closing date, not through proper channel, or without ACRs and required certificates will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation (including short-term contract). Period of deputation, including immediately preceding ex-cadre post in Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed three years. Post classified General Central Service Group 'B' Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Office of the Commissioner of Railway Safety, Southern Circle, Bengaluru.
